text:
sam (support): Hey team, Lina filed an urgent customer escalation — multiple 502/504s for hosted inference after the tenant-merge rollout at ~09:10 UTC. Impacting a single large tenant, ~15% error rate on short-text gen calls. Customer is seeing failed completions and timeouts. cc @morgan @jia :exclamation:

lina (cs): Customer says errors started immediately after we merged tenant headers and sent a follow-up deployment 09:08-09:12. They pasted a sample curl with trace-id.

sam (support): Sample request: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Tenant: ACME" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 502, resp body `{"error":"upstream reset"}`. Trace id: `trace=7f9a2d1a-ct-101` (from client).

morgan (eng-sre): :eyes: grabbing envoy/edge logs for that trace range. Which regions affected?

sam (support): AP and US-west both reported; EU limited. Customer traffic primarily US-west.

jia (oncall): I see a burst of `502` from edge-proxy around 09:09-09:14 in prod-usw. Envoy logs show `upstream connection error or reset` with `downstream_remote_close` and `no healthy upstream`.

eli (infra): That aligns with midproxy (auth-front) ejection events. I spotted h2 stream resets and circuit-breaker triggered on auth pool for that tenant. Could be header merge increasing concurrent connections to auth and exhausting its keepalive pool.

morgan (eng-sre): Can we get a compact log snippet? Jia, paste the envoy line for the trace id.

jia (oncall): Log snippet (masked):
```
[09:10:02.123] envoy access_log: upstream_response_time=0.003, response_code=502, response_flags=UR, trace=7f9a2d1a-ct-101, upstream_host=10.2.7.45:443, x-envoy-upstream-service-time=0.004
[09:10:02.123] envoy: error "upstream connect error or disconnect" details=\"stream reset\"
```

sam (support): Customer also reported increased latency prior to 502 spike — some 200-400ms tail on successful requests.

eli (infra): Hypothesis: tenant header change caused auth service to route to a smaller pool (tenant-mapping shard) which hit connpool limits under burst. Auth returned 200 for some, but closed streams early for others.

morgan (eng-sre): Steps to repro locally: 1) run large parallel short-gen requests with X-Tenant header set; 2) target prod-usw ingress endpoint; 3) observe auth pool metrics and envoy conn queues. I can script a quick load test.

sam (support): Customer provided request pattern: bursts of 300rps for ~30s, many short short requests (1-50 tokens). They used keepalive across many connections (curl from many hosts).

lina (cs): Customer is pushing for a workaround while we triage — any non-disruptive mitigations?

jia (oncall): Short term: enable fallback route policy for that tenant to route to a cold replica without going through the auth front (requires config change, low risk). Also increase auth pool size for tenant shard (fast config).

eli (infra): I can bump per-tenant connpool to +50 for that shard (in prod) and enable explicit keepalive timeout alignment between edge and auth. Doing that now as a quick mitigation.

ci-bot: deploy triggered: infra/tenant-pool-increase -> prod-usw. Deployment id: deploy-2026-03-18-09:25.

morgan (eng-sre): While infra rolls, I'll run a targeted repro script to emulate 300rps with X-Tenant and collect envoy and midproxy histograms. If we reproduce, we'll capture stack traces and heap/FD stats.

sam (support): Customer notified and asked for ETA. Lina updated them: mitigation in progress, monitoring for recovery in next 5-10m.

eli (infra): Bumped pool and aligned keepalive. Watching metrics: auth connection utilization dropped from 98% -> 42% in ~90s. Error rate decreasing.

morgan (eng-sre): Confirming: error rate per-tenant fell to 0.8% after change, avg latency back to baseline. Repro run shows no 502s at 300rps for 2m.

lina (cs): Customer confirmed service returning to normal, thanks. They request root cause write-up and permanent fix.

morgan (eng-sre): Action items: 1) root cause doc (me) — auth shard sizing + connpool defaults + header-driven shard hotspots; 2) infra change (eli) — make per-tenant connpool autoscale and ensure keepalive parity; 3) product (sam/lina) — add tenant-aware rollout checks to avoid simultaneous header routing changes; 4) add an alert for per-tenant auth conn saturation.

sam (support): I'll file a postmortem ticket and link customer notes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
